result: Designed and built the per-run skill activity log (clause v4 writer, gate, transcript backfill, report, catalog fields, librarian skills pass); landing blocked by a parallel session's WIP.
comment: Two waves, eight questions, all recommendations accepted plus one operator extension (provider/model/effort). Scouts were decisive: the usage/signals privacy law and the absence of any token source reshaped the design before the first question. The standard read (diagnosis withheld from the executor) became a clause rule. Friction: HEAD was already gate-red from an unrelated stale index, and landing onto the shared checkout collided with foreign WIP in four files - the go-gate should have computed that overlap. Builders returned clean work with good judgment calls (catalog window anchored to newest row, pending file at checkout root).
